description:
Read a carrier's current registration fields, documents and address requirements.

        The response's ``subject_types`` lists the applicant types the carrier accepts.
        US local SMS registration uses ``purpose="sms"``, country ``US`` and type ``local``.
        Toll-free verification uses ``purpose="sms"``, the number's country ``US`` or ``CA``,
        type ``toll_free`` and its owned ``number_id``. Each number needs its own verification.
        Applicant country and business tax status determine the registration route.
        The personal route is available to US or Canadian applicants without a business tax number.
        Local 10DLC fees apply at submission, carrier review and monthly after approval.
        Toll-free verification is free and sends no identity confirmation code.

        Returns ``required``, ``fields``, ``documents`` and ``address_required``.
        ``required=false`` means a registration submission is unnecessary and would fail.
        Fields and files require accurate information supplied by the authorized applicant.
        Choice fields accept comma-separated option keys within their ``min_choices`` and ``max_choices``.
        Field ``max_length`` uses UTF-16 code units; an emoji counts as two.
        Selected consent methods can require evidence even when shared fields are optional.
        No public link for an ``*_evidence_url`` field? Upload the screenshot with
        ``create_file_upload`` (purpose ``sms_evidence``) and use the ``url`` it returns.
        Document slots with ``needs_input=false`` require no upload.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_id.description: The owned number this registration is for: its ID from ``list_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Give it for toll-free texting and when the form asks for the sending number; otherwise leave it out.
number_id.title: Number Id

number_type.description: The kind of number this registration covers. Copy it from the offer in ``quote_numbers`` or the number in ``list_numbers``.
number_type.title: Number Type

purpose.description: What the registration is for: ``number`` registers the applicant so a number can be bought; ``sms`` registers US texting (local 10DLC or toll-free).
purpose.title: Purpose

quote_id.description: The offer to register for: its ``quote_id`` from ``quote_numbers``, which selects that offer's form. Give it when ``purpose`` is ``number``; leave it out for ``sms``.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

subject_type.description: Who the registration is for: the user themselves (``person``) or their company (``business``).
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: get_verification_requirements

DocumentOption.description: One accepted way to fill a document slot (e.g. passport or ID card).

copies.description: Names of the customer's own fields copied onto this document automatically.
copies.title: Copies

fields.description: Extra values this document needs. Send them in the slot's `fields`.
fields.title: Fields

file_required.description: True when the customer must upload a file for this option.
file_required.title: File Required

key.description: Value to send as `option` for this document type.
key.title: Key

label.description: Label to show the customer, e.g. 'Passport'.
label.title: Label

needs_address.description: True when this document refers to the address the customer gave.
needs_address.title: Needs Address

DocumentOption.title: DocumentOption

DocumentSlot.description: A required proof (identity, address, registration) with its options.

label.description: Label to show the customer, e.g. 'Proof of identity'.
label.title: Label

name.description: Key for this slot in `documents` and in the `file.<name>` part.
name.title: Name

needs_input.description:
False when there is nothing to ask: one option, no file, no extra
values. The UI hides such a slot; the plug-in still fills it.
needs_input.title: Needs Input

options.description: The accepted ways to fill this slot. The customer picks one.
options.title: Options

DocumentSlot.title: DocumentSlot

FieldOption.description: One allowed value for a field with a fixed set of answers.
FieldOption.title: FieldOption

FieldSpec.description: One value the customer types in.

kind.description: Input kind: 'text', 'email', 'phone', 'url', or 'choices' (pick several of `options`; send their keys joined by commas).
kind.title: Kind

max_choices.description: For kind 'choices': the most options to pick.
max_choices.title: Max Choices

max_length.description: The most characters the value may hold, when known, counted in UTF-16 code units (an emoji counts as 2). Enforced: a longer value gets 422. A form can show a field allowed more than about 100 characters as a box that wraps.
max_length.title: Max Length

min_choices.description: For kind 'choices': the fewest options to pick.
min_choices.title: Min Choices

name.description: Key to send this value under in `fields`.
name.title: Name

options.description: Allowed values, when the field is a choice. Show a select, not a text box.
options.title: Options

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match, when the carrier gives one.
pattern.title: Pattern

required.description: False when the field is optional.
required.title: Required

FieldSpec.title: FieldSpec

anyOf.description:
What the carrier needs for one (country, number type, subject type),
as the public API shows it: without the carrier's name.

address_required.description: True when an address must be collected.
address_required.title: Address Required

documents.description: Documents to collect. Skip slots with `needs_input` false.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Values to collect about the person or business.
fields.title: Fields

required.description: False when the carrier needs no verification for this combination.
required.title: Required

subject_types.description: Subject types the carrier accepts here, so you can offer the choice.
subject_types.title: Subject Types

anyOf.title: VerificationRequirements
